key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by modeling the full reasoning process, not just the problem stem, to better judge pedagogical value across concepts, difficulty, and competencies.
engineering_relevance: For AI-assisted education systems, this provides a scalable way to filter and validate generated math items before deployment.
method: Formulated IQA under three process-aware dimensions: knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies.
Built a process-enhanced dataset by augmenting items with structured reasoning trees from raw solutions.
Encoded reasoning trees with GNNs and fused them with stem semantics in a dual-view "Stem + Solving" architecture.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on K12 math datasets showing that ProIQA captures process-oriented features and improves fine-grained assessment.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of LLM-generated reasoning trees, which may introduce noise or bias if the solutions are incomplete or incorrect.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
